query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

action.query: Apple iPhone latest model buy iPhone 2026 site:apple.com
queries: Apple iPhone latest model buy iPhone 2026 site:apple.com

content.text:
You can buy the **latest iPhone models directly from Apple**—Apple’s current “New” lineup includes **iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone Air, and iPhone 17**. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/buy-iphone/iphone-16-pro/6.9-inch-display-256gb-desert-titanium-unlocked?utm_source=openai))

Best places to buy in the U.S.:

- **Apple Store / Apple.com** — buy unlocked or with a carrier, choose shipping or in-store pickup, and use Apple Trade In.
- **Carrier stores** — **Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Boost Mobile**; often best if you want monthly bill credits or a plan deal.
- **Major retailers** — **Best Buy, Costco, Walmart, Target**; availability and promos vary by location.

If you want the safest route: buy from **Apple directly**, especially if you want an **unlocked** iPhone or help transferring your data. Apple also offers trade-in credit and free shipping/pickup options. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/buy-iphone/iphone-16/6.1-inch-display-256gb-ultramarine-boost-mobile?utm_source=openai))
